classification: Derived post hoc activity verification of already frozen observed outcomes; outside canonical quality audit

method.scope: Read-only stdlib pass over all730 new records and immutable referenced controls; no selector, packer, model, retrieval, index or fresh-corpus execution.
method.controls: Verified each referenced original control line number, canonical record SHA, full-response SHA and exact compact SHA; every candidate reference_response exactly equals its coverage control.
method.activity: Activation from actual planner receipt; proposal from actual plan.accepted; eligible changes compare baseline_eligible_ids with actual eligible stage; actual guard acceptance/fallback from captured actual guard receipt.
method.final_compact_changes: Exact stored compact text comparison against original coverage-control payload, cross-checked against content hashes.
method.actual_source: Sets of (path, inclusive physical line number, exact CR/LF/CRLF line bytes, source-overlay key presence and values); source changes ignore order and metadata-only differences.
method.planned_added_id_delivery: Counts only actual final result rows whose original ID appears in the planner added_ids. Containing rows with different IDs are not counted as delivered planned IDs.
method.new_actual_source: At least one actual delivered physical source line absent from the union of actual coverage-control source lines with the same path and overlay provenance; no full-window or gold credit.
method.distinct_source_fragments: Deduplicated (dataset,path,start_line,end_line,actual source_hash), so clipped variants count as distinct fragments. Dataset/ID and fragment counts are not independent trials.
method.fallbacks: All guard failures, including inactive plans, retained; accepted_plan_guard_fallback isolates actual proposed changes rejected after packing.
method.limitations: Derived post hoc operational counts, not a new candidate, quality qualification, independent audit, timing measurement, generalization result or coding/billing claim.
